_purpose: Sprint 12 / A4 — T1 影子期：mount.requested 由消费方（agint-mutator / agint-population）publish 到 bus，订阅方（agint-mount）通过总线接收到 mount.requested。**双轨不切流量**：eventBusReceived=true AND 消费方直连路径（publishMountRequest 返回 published=true）不受影响。

_steps: 1. 加载 agint-event-bus 真 plugin apply(ctx) — 提供 3 service（publish/subscribe/inspect）
2. 加载 agint-mutator 真 plugin apply(ctx) — 拿到 publishMountRequest service
3. 加载 agint-population 真 plugin apply(ctx) — 拿到 publishMountRequest service
4. 注册 agint-mount 订阅者：subscribe({subscriber:'agint-mount', topics:['mount.requested'], mode:'async'}, handler)
5. 调 agint.mutator.publishMountRequest({proposalId, decision:'AUTO_DEPLOY'}) → 应 publish 到 bus + handler 触发
7. 校验 inspect 日志含 envelope topic=mount.requested + payload.ticketId/proposalId/decision 完整
